name: Transporting Packages
pages: In addition to other methods of transporting items, {i}package frogports{/}, {i}postboxes{/}, and {i}robo bee ports{/} can be used to {b}send{/} and {b}receive{/} {l:logistics/packages/}packages{/l} directly.

pages.title: Frogports
pages.text: A {i}frogport{/} must be linked to a {i}chain conveyor{/}. It will {b}send{/} packages from the container it sits on to the {i}chain conveyor{/}, or {b}take{/} packages from the {i}chain conveyor{/} and deposit them into the container, if the {i}frogport's{/} {!}name{/} matches the {l:logistics/packages/}package address{/l}.

pages.title: Postboxes
pages.text: Similarly, a {i}postbox{/} must be linked to a {i}train station{/}. Trains can {b}deliver{/} packages to a {i}postbox{/} with a matching {l:logistics/packages/}package address{/l} when it stops at the {i}station{/}, or {b}collect{/} packages from the {i}postbox{/} linked to that {i}station{/}.

pages.title: Robo Bee Ports
pages.text: A {i}robo bee port{/} can send out {i}robo bees{/} to {b}automatically deliver{/} {l:logistics/packages/}packages{/l} directly to {!}players{/} or other {i}bee ports{/}.{pb}Use these together with a linked {i}portable stock ticker{/} to access your {l:logistics/stock_networks/}stock network{/l} from anywhere in the world!
